name: TackQuote
author: TackQuote
description: MUST be installed from a file named exactly tack.ocmod.zip — OpenCart takes the extension code from the ZIP FILENAME, and every namespace and event action in this package hard-codes 'tack', so a zip under any other name installs successfully and then returns 404 on every route. The "code" field below is NOT what sets it. Adds a "Request a Quote" button to your product pages, and lets TackQuote read this store's catalog and orders and place quote-accepted orders.
